relation: one input is evaluated by one supplied binary condition and follows exactly one of two mutually exclusive branches

stageEvents.observable: one input and one downstream condition are readable
the input reaches the condition and its supplied boolean result is visible
both mutually exclusive labeled outcomes are readable before selection
exactly one branch is emphasized while the alternative stays visible but inactive
the selected outcome resolves to one final result

limits: exactly two mutually exclusive labeled outcomes
exactly one selected branch from a supplied condition result
unselected branch remains visible but inactive
no nested decision, merge, loop, parallel execution, probability, or weighting
condition order does not imply causality beyond the supplied rule
